role: Minister-Delegate for Foreign Trade and Attractiveness
organization: Government of France (Lecornu government), attached to the Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs
description: Appointed Minister-Delegate in charge of Foreign Trade (Commerce exterieur) and Attractiveness on 12 October 2025; retained the post in the 26 February 2026 reshuffle. Succeeded Laurent Saint-Martin.

role: Member of the National Assembly for Indre's 2nd constituency
description: Elected in 2017, re-elected in 2022 and 2024. Member of the Foreign Affairs Committee (since 2020), previously Finance Committee; special rapporteur for Foreign Trade.

role: Member of the National Assembly for Indre's 2nd constituency
description: Returned to the National Assembly in 2007 after his ministerial term; member of the Finance Committee and rapporteur of the agricultural budget. Defeated in 2012.

role: Member of the National Assembly for Indre's 2nd constituency
description: First elected in 1993, re-elected in 1997 and 2002. Member of the Production Committee (1993-2002) then Finance Committee; rapporteur of the foreign-trade budget (1997-2003). Seat vacated on appointment to government.

role: Secretary of State for Agriculture, Food, Fisheries and Rural Affairs
organization: Government of France (3rd and 4th Raffarin governments)
description: Junior minister (secretaire d'Etat) under Agriculture Ministers Herve Gaymard and Dominique Bussereau in the government of Prime Minister Jean-Pierre Raffarin.
Mayor of La Chatre for 22 years; named honorary mayor (maire honoraire) by the prefect of Indre in 2017. Previously deputy mayor / municipal councillor from 1989.

role: President of the Communaute de communes de La Chatre et Sainte-Severe
organization: Communaute de communes de La Chatre et Sainte-Severe
description: Headed the inter-municipal cooperation body of the La Chatre area for roughly two decades.

role: Member of the Regional Council of Centre-Val de Loire
organization: Regional Council of Centre-Val de Loire
description: Elected regional councillor in 2015; led the centre-right opposition ticket in the 2021 regional election, finishing second behind incumbent president Francois Bonneau (PS).

role: Chairman of the board of directors
organization: Centre francais du commerce exterieur / Ubifrance
description: Chaired the board of the French foreign-trade promotion agency (then Centre francais du commerce exterieur, later Ubifrance).

role: National mediator for farmers (Mediateur national des agriculteurs)
description: Served as national mediator for farmers, a public-service mission on agricultural disputes.

role: National Secretary (UMP), including for foreign trade
description: National secretary of the UMP (2002-2005) and again national secretary in charge of foreign trade (2008).

organization: Generale Medias, Le Figaro / Groupe Hersant, Imprimerie George Sand
description: Sales role at Generale Medias (1988-1989); advertising manager at Le Figaro then advertising director of 'Business in the USSR' within the Hersant group (1989-1992); advertising director at the journal Profession politique; manager of the George Sand printing works in La Chatre (1992-2004).
